## Purpose of proposed change

Describe the bug or improvement and include any related issue number.

## Security and user data

- [ ] Changes do not expose credentials, unpublished documents or user data
- [ ] Existing stored workouts and profile history are protected
- [ ] Appropriate tests and release gates have been run

## Rights and permission — required before any outside contribution is merged

- [ ] The project owner has authorized this contribution
- [ ] Any outside contributor has signed the applicable written IP/contribution agreement
- [ ] All code, artwork and source references have documented provenance and compatible permissions
- [ ] Third-party and AI-generated materials are identified where relevant

**No copyright transfer occurs automatically from opening a pull request.**
